name: Iran
description: Follow Iran, a tracked place, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: U.S. soldier killed in Iraq, Trump orders more strikes against Iran
changes.summary: A U.S. service member was killed in Iraq on Saturday, CENTCOM announced. Separately, unidentified remains were found in Jordan at the location where a U.S. service member went missing and two others were killed following an Iranian strike. Taurean Small reports.

changes.title: Oil Prices Cross $90 a Barrel as U.S.-Iran Conflict Widens
changes.summary: Brent crude, the global benchmark for oil, rose more than 3 percent as trading resumed on Sunday, while S&P 500 futures remained essentially unchanged.

changes.title: Rubio Says That U.S. Is Still Open to Diplomacy With Iran
changes.summary: Secretary of State Marco Rubio also said that Iran has signaled it wants to negotiate with the United States, even as the two sides escalated their attacks.

changes.title: Morning news brief
changes.summary: The U.S. carries out a wave of strikes against Iran, as fighting between the two escalates, Congress faces long to-do list as August recess approaches, Andy Burnham becomes U.K.'s 7th prime minister.

changes.title: U.S. Average Gas Price Returns to $4 a Gallon as Iran Crisis Escalates
changes.summary: A month ago, drivers were enjoying some relief at the pump after the U.S. and Iran signed a deal intended to reopen the Strait of Hormuz. Now, prices are rising again.

changes.title: US Fires at Iran After 3 US Service Members Killed in Middle East
changes.summary: The United States is firing back against Iran after the deaths of at least three U.S. service members in the Middle East. The American death toll in the war now stands at 17. NBC’s Keir Simmons reports for TODAY.

changes.title: 3 U.S. personnel killed in Iran conflict. And, Hunter Biden opens up to NPR
changes.summary: Three U.S. service members have been killed since Friday amid rising tension between the U.S. and Iran. And, Hunter Biden talks to NPR's Newsmakers about addiction and public scrutiny. (Image credit: Atta Kenare).

changes.title: Steve Forbes urges Trump to keep the Strait of Hormuz open at all costs
changes.summary: Steve Forbes says the United States must double down on efforts to topple the Tehran regime, arguing that free passage through the Strait of Hormuz should remain a non-negotiable American imperative. changes.title: Trump could ‘do something positive’ rather than fixate on 2020 loss, Fetterman says
changes.summary: Senator says Trump revisiting failed run against Biden ‘distracts from important things’ such as Iran war Rather than continue fixating on the 2020 election defeat that ended his first presidency, Donald Trump could instead “do something positive”, including resolving the US war in Iran , Pennsylvania senator John Fett.

changes.title: Increased Cooperation With U.S. Has Put Jordan in Iran’s Cross Hairs
changes.summary: Jordan’s role in U.S. operations against Iran has grown as other allies in the region have restricted Washington’s ability to use their bases and airspace.
